trainingData: Original source OpenVLA-OFT/π0.5 checkpoints as track-specific; ActPrune geometric pruning needs no newly trained policy/selector, while original policies were pretrained and some source-specific tasks fine-tuned. Two cameras, calibrated geometry and wrist RGBD.
evaluationNotes: 25% visual retained, OFT baseline consistent. M×M means coarse grid of reprojected context patches; a grid of zero discards pruned patches.
